topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I stepped through the door, the evening air bringing a gentle coolness after the warmth of the day. My phone buzzed with a message from Sarah: "Sorry, can't make it tonight. Plans changed." At first, a small twinge of confusion. Then, as more messages trickled in, a clearer picture formed. The surprise party, it seemed, had been called off. No rush of disappointment or anger, just a faint sense of things not aligning as planned. I took a deep breath, the night still young, and thought about what to do with this unexpected stretch of time. A quiet evening, perhaps, with a book or a long-overdue phone call to an old friend.
